spots.name: Carter Wen
spots.text: Roadwolves hit the toll cart at dawn. If you go east, keep to the road. Forest is where they wait.
dialogue: 'I used to run the east road twice a week. Then the toll cart came back with its wheels still turning and no horses.'
'The wolves are not all beasts. Their chief pays deserters in silver and lets them keep whatever they can carry.'

spots.name: Village Guard
spots.text: Hask Gravelteeth's camp lies far to the east, past the old watchtower road. Bring more than three blades.
dialogue: 'The watchtower bell rings when the wind is from the north. Last night it rang with no wind at all.'
'If you find a brass token in the mud, don't spend it. The old road wardens used those to open the sealed storehouse.'

spots.name: Carter Wen, Convoy Master
spots.text: Carter Wen has returned to Sallow Crossing with mud to his knees and a torn convoy ribbon in his hand. “The last wagons are still out there. We cannot save everything. We can decide who gets home.”
dialogue: “The manifest lists flour, lamp oil, and twelve families. The ridge has been watched by men who wear no house colours.”

spots.name: The Changed Escort
spots.text: A diplomatic escort has been ordered to turn a marked supply train back at the narrow crossing. The wagons carry displaced families.

spots.name: The Price of a Crossing
spots.text: The river road is open, but only one priority convoy can cross before the weather turns.

spots.name: Innkeeper Maud
spots.text: Rest your feet, captain. Beds are full of drovers tonight, but the stew is hot and the gossip is free.
dialogue: 'A warm bed buys a man one honest night. A good story buys the next three.'
'The drover in the corner lost his brother near the old tower. He says the stones whisper names after rain.'

spots.name: Drover
spots.text: Heard a purse was left in the old tower, north of here. Nobody dares go. The roads are not what they were.

spots.name: Shopkeeper Oswin
spots.text: Blades, mail, charms and sigils, all honestly priced. And your company's kit can be sorted out right here at the counter.
dialogue: Oswin rubs a thumb over a scar in the counter. 'A rune is not a bauble. It remembers every hand that has carried it.'
'I can seat a rune safely, or draw one out without cracking the socket. A field swap is how good steel gets ruined.'
'Bring me three of the same mark for the Forge. Their grades need not match, but a well-trained rune gives the ritual a steadier chance.'

spots.name: Elder Hale
spots.text: Elder Hale unlocks a narrow chest beneath the table. Inside lies the old toll book, its last pages stained by river water.
dialogue: “I kept this because the names mattered. The convoy manifest may show which entries were false — and who was made to vanish from the road.”

spots.name: Gate Warden
spots.text: The walls are cracked, but they hold. Steward Brannoch is waiting in the great hall.

spots.name: Mira, the Wellkeeper
spots.text: Mira keeps a strip of clean linen tied around her wrist. “I can make a bucket last three days. I cannot make a well out of rubble.”
dialogue: “The old shaft was built before the keep's western wall. If we clear it, test it, and keep the first water for the sick, we can stay.”

spots.name: Hobb, the Carpenter
spots.text: Hobb studies the torn rafters and the folded house banner. “A banner is cloth. A roof keeps people alive.”
dialogue: “The stable collapsed in the last winter. Some of its beams are sound. We can salvage them before the next storm.”

spots.name: Steward Brannoch
spots.text: Steward Brannoch has summoned the household to the great hall. He will not ask for an oath until the keep's people and the road have been accounted for.
dialogue: “A house is not restored when its doors open. It is restored when people know what its word is worth.”
“Bring me the wellkeeper's report, the carpenter's word, Carter's convoy manifest and Elder Hale's toll record. Then we will speak of the first oath.”

spots.name: War Table
spots.text: The war table: sort your company, gear, sigils and promotions here, or send for the market stock.
dialogue: 'Scouts have marked three approaches: river, ridge and forest. Each battlefield will answer differently to the ground beneath your boots.'
'Take the high ground where you can. A narrow ford is a fine place to hold a line, and a poor place to retreat.'

spots.name: Master Smith Rurik
spots.text: Rurik's arms are black with forge soot. He measures every blade as if it were a promise.
dialogue: 'Steel has a memory. Every temper leaves a little of the smith in it.'
'I can improve a weapon or armor to +15. I can also draw socketed runes without damaging them. Nothing is free but advice.'

spots.name: Sergeant Voss
spots.text: Spears sharp, boots dry. Give the word and we march. Rear attacks and flanks win fights, captain. Remember it.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: The Boundary Tree
spots.text: A felled boundary tree has reopened a dispute over woodland rights, tenant fields and old coppice paths.

spots.name: Three Bridges
spots.text: The river road has become a military lifeline. Three crossings and a downstream storehouse must be secured before the evacuation can continue.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: A clean bed and a hot meal cost 20 gold. Your company can recover its nerve here.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The Weald's best bowyers and charm-sellers trade here. Use the party counter to compare and buy equipment.

spots.name: Lucan Thorne
spots.text: A steady yeoman captain, once sworn to House Orrowen. He will travel with you if you can offer a place in the company.

spots.name: Joss Harrow
spots.text: A quick-handed smuggler who knows every back room between the coast and the March. He asks for 50 gold and a chance to choose his own risks.

spots.name: Tomas Wren
spots.text: A fearless young messenger who has outrun three patrols. He wants a company that will let him prove himself.

spots.name: Verra Nightsong
spots.text: A singer with a spy's memory and a diplomat's smile. She will only trust a company that has already earned Joss Harrow's confidence.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The herbwives keep a quiet room for weary travellers. Rest costs 20 gold.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Foxglove trades in herbs, bows and travel gear. The quartermaster can arrange your equipment.

spots.name: Old Brisa
spots.text: A village elder and healer. She asks no oath, only that the company protect the road folk.

spots.name: Edda Stonehand
spots.text: A blunt siege-wright from Brennhallow. She is searching for proof that the old tollhouse stores can supply a rebuilt workshop.

spots.name: Bram Cullen
spots.text: A gentle giant with a pit-fighter's scars. The camp must be cleared before he will risk joining another armed company.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: The Orrowen Hearing
spots.text: Four witnesses have gathered to speak about the disputed levy and boundary order.

spots.name: The Banner in the Reeds
spots.text: A hostile banner moves through the reed beds, but Sela has seen civilians beneath it.

spots.name: The Witness Who Recanted
spots.text: The Orrowen witness has withdrawn their account. Their family has been threatened, and they refuse to be used as proof without their consent.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The timber hall offers a dry bed and a warm fire for 20 gold.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Carpenters and hunters bring their wares to the square. The factor can open your company stores.

spots.name: Kestrel
spots.text: A silent scout with an old contract to settle. A place among your outriders will do.

spots.name: Lady Isaure Vessmoor
spots.text: A proud heir stripped of her lands. She will speak after the Vessmoor gate is opened and the road is safe.

spots.name: Ser Willem Roake
spots.text: A disciplined duelist who accepts no commander lightly. He follows only after Lady Isaure has joined.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Red Mare charges 20 gold for a night's rest and a stable for your mounts.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The central market carries Vessmoor steel, tack and provisions. Visit the counter to manage your gear.

spots.name: Anselm Pike
spots.text: A veteran sergeant with a dry wit and a gift for keeping recruits alive. He will join a disciplined company.

spots.name: Garrick Holt
spots.text: A defeated heavy-knight commander. Spare the Catacombs' guardian and prove that honour can outlive defeat.

spots.name: Lord Corwin Brennhallow
spots.text: The Regent's conflicted son. He will not leave the capital before the fourth act begins.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Ferry House offers a meal and a bed for 20 gold.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: Ferry traders sell river gear and imported goods. The factor can access your party shop.

spots.name: Petra Quill
spots.text: A blunt field surgeon who left a noble household after refusing to abandon wounded levies.

spots.name: Sister Odalys
spots.text: A former inquisitor seeking atonement. She asks that the Kingsroad Catacombs be cleansed before she takes up arms again.

spots.name: Seraphine Tarnholt
spots.text: A healer-knight whose faith has survived too many failures. Her story begins in the fourth act.

spots.name: Town Crier
spots.text: The roads east and south are open. Keep to the marked stones after dusk.

spots.name: Innkeeper
spots.text: The Garrison Inn provides a guarded room for 20 gold.

spots.name: Market Factor
spots.text: The mile market stocks practical arms and armour for the southern road.

spots.name: Dorian Vask
spots.text: A pragmatic mercenary captain. He asks for a fair share and a clear chain of command.

spots.name: Orlan Pike
spots.text: An exiled fire scholar who waits for the Bell Under Leaves to fall silent before returning to the field.

spots.name: Ysolde Marrow
spots.text: A strategic ice mage and merchant's daughter. She joins after Verra's negotiations open the Ysmark route.

spots.name: Ilyan Voss
spots.text: A former tower guard turned battle mage. His loyalty is pledged to the later campaign, not a passing contract.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A rusted strongbox contains 120 gold and a map fragment. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Rootbound Warden
spots.text: A former road captain has become the keeper of this den. He has chained the old tunnel doors and refuses to let the dead rest.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A votive coffer holds 120 gold and a silver woodland token. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Bell-Keeper
spots.text: The last keeper guards the bronze bell, convinced its toll is the only thing keeping a buried plague asleep.

spots.name: Sealed Cache
spots.text: A sealed royal chest contains 120 gold and a signet fragment. A singular relic rests beneath the coins.

spots.name: The Ashen Reeve
spots.text: A disgraced Vessmoor reeve commands the ossuary's looters, claiming the crown still owes his family a debt.

spots.name: Captain Ilyra Venn
spots.text: The Assembly calls this a port. The sailors call it the last honest light before the black current. Three beacon crews vanished in one month.
dialogue: A sealed lighthouse ledger was carried into Tideglass Grotto before the last keeper disappeared.
Bring the ledger back intact. I will put the truth before the Assembly, even if it costs me my chair.

spots.name: Tidebound Factor
spots.text: Charts, rope, salt-proof mail and provisions. No one sails the outer shoals without a proper line.

spots.name: Maren Vey
spots.text: A quiet pilot who knows the reefs by the sound of water against stone. Maren will only sail with a company that brings the Tideglass ledger back.

spots.name: The Lantern & Keel
spots.text: A warm room above the tide stairs. The keeper serves fish stew and keeps a dry chart table.

spots.name: Net-mender Ossa
spots.text: The tide pools have gone quiet. Even the gulls avoid the northern rocks. My brother saw lanterns moving under the water.

spots.name: The Brackish Cup
spots.text: The keeper offers a dry bed and a bowl of hot shellfish broth.

spots.name: Beacon Apprentice
spots.text: The old signal lens was removed three nights before the beacon went dark. The official log says it was never there.

spots.name: Quay Provisioner
spots.text: Fresh rope, lamp oil and travel gear for the coast road.

spots.name: Keeper's Strongbox
spots.text: Inside is a salt-stained chart and the missing lighthouse ledger. The last page bears the Seven Flames seal, deliberately scraped away.

spots.name: The Reef Warden
spots.text: A former beacon guard stands between you and the outer chamber. He has been ordered to keep the ledger buried, but his hands shake when he sees the seal.

spots.name: Archive Registrar
spots.text: The custodians of the Quillon Archive will hear a petition, but the sealed stacks are not open to force without consequence.

spots.name: Index Keeper
spots.text: The index records who consulted each volume. Several names were struck out by Edmer's own hand.

spots.name: Custodian of Seals
spots.text: An original can survive a generation in a locked room. A copy can survive a fire. Neither choice is neutral.

spots.name: The Last Audience
spots.text: The city council has gathered beneath the old imperial dome. Maelor waits beside the empty throne, with the Seven Witnesses' evidence laid out where everyone can see it.

spots.name: Aurelmont Gate Warden
spots.text: The capital has not closed its gates, but neither has it agreed to welcome an army. Every banner outside is being counted.
